title: El Paste de Real del Monte, MEXI STORIES
comment: paste-realdelmonte (MEXI): pastería familiar en Real del Monte, Hidalgo. Caras comunes, no famosas; los tres se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.DANIELA_ROMERO: Mexican woman from Hidalgo, paste baker, 23 years old, light skin with rosy cheeks, brown hair in a messy bun, a grey wool sweater with rolled-up sleeves, a white apron dusted with flour, jeans, black sneakers, her hands empty.
chars.ROGELIO_ROMERO: Mexican man from Hidalgo, 52 years old, stocky, light-brown skin, short black-and-grey hair, a black beard with grey, a dark-blue quilted work jacket, a grey knitted beanie, jeans, work boots, a small black backpack on one shoulder, his hands empty.
chars.KARLA_MONTIEL: Mexican woman, 40 years old, light skin, wavy platinum-blonde dyed hair, long pink acrylic nails, heavy eyelashes, a pink satin robe over pajamas, fluffy white slippers, holding a smartphone.

locs.LOC_PASTERIA: Small family paste bakery in Real del Monte, Hidalgo, on a cold foggy morning: a long wooden kneading table covered in flour with dough and golden pastes, an old brick oven, a glass display case, an open doorway to a small living room with a worn sofa, a window to a misty hillside town with colorful houses and pine trees, warm lamp light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
